**The app in Chinese**
- Nilesoft Shell Pro is available in Simplified Chinese (简体中文) and Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) as well as English. By default it follows the Windows display language: Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan get Traditional Chinese, other Chinese locales Simplified Chinese.
- *Preferences > Language* chooses the language yourself (Auto, English, 简体中文, 繁體中文). The change applies at once, without restarting the app.
- Dates in *Backups* follow the language's own order.
- The translations are built into `NilesoftShellPro.exe`, so it is still a single file. To translate the app into another language, see `src/settings/README.md`. Corrections from native speakers are welcome in [Discussions](https://github.com/Abdullah-Masood-05/Shell/discussions).

**Updates now reach your menu files**
- If you use a personal configuration (`%APPDATA%\Nilesoft\Shell`), it keeps its own copies of the shipped menu files, and until now updates never touched them, so fixes to those files never reached you. After an update, the app now brings every copy you haven't edited up to date, after saving a snapshot in *Backups*. Files you edited are kept; Home lists them, with *Compare* and *Use the new version*.
- `shell -config:upgrade` does the same from the command line.

**Context Menus page**
- Each rule for Windows items is described in one plain sentence in your language, for example "Moves Copy as path into File manage", with the menu names and Windows item names as you see them in the menu.
- Positions are counted the way Shell counts them: `pos=1` is the second item.

**Chinese**
- Simplified Chinese wording reviewed by zhonglixun, plus a wording pass over Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
- Two- and three-option buttons give every option the same width, so the highlight lines up with the label in every language.
